ucs.title: [LLM] BlackByte ProxyShell/ProxyNotShell Exchange exploitation → IIS w3wp.exe spawning recon LOLBins
ucs.description: Hunts BlackByte's signature initial-access chain: exploitation of public-facing Exchange servers (ProxyShell/ProxyNotShell) followed by w3wp.exe spawning native discovery/credential-access tooling. BlackByte is well-documented (Microsoft, CISA #AA22-238A, Symantec/Broadcom) as breaching victims via unpatched Exchange and immediately running AD recon via the IIS worker process before deploying their ransomware.
ucs.splunk: | tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as process values(Processes.process_id) as process_id values(Processes.user) as user from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name="w3wp.exe" (Processes.process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","nltest.exe","whoami.exe","ipconfig.exe","systeminfo.exe","tasklist.exe","wmic.exe","bitsadmin.exe","certutil.exe","ntdsutil.exe") OR Processes.process IN ("*Get-ADUser*","*Get-ADComputer*","*Get-DomainTrust*","*nltest*/domain_trusts*","*net*group*Domain Admins*","*whoami*/all*","*ntdsutil*ifm*")) by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.process_id Processes.parent_process_id | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)` | where user!="SYSTEM" OR process_name!="cmd.exe" | stats values(process) as commandlines values(process_name) as child_procs dc(process_name) as distinct_children min(firstTime) as firstTime max(lastTime) as lastTime by dest user | where distinct_children >= 2
ucs.kql:
// BlackByte (G1043) — w3wp.exe (IIS/Exchange) spawning recon + LOLBin tools
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let ReconChildren = dynamic(["powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","nltest.exe","whoami.exe","ipconfig.exe","systeminfo.exe","tasklist.exe","wmic.exe","bitsadmin.exe","certutil.exe","ntdsutil.exe","sc.exe","reg.exe"]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "w3wp.exe"
| where InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any ("MSExchange","DefaultAppPool")    // BlackByte target = Exchange w3wp app pool
   or InitiatingProcessFolderPath has @"\Exchange Server\"
| where FileName in~ (ReconChildren)
   or ProcessCommandLine has_any (
        "Get-ADUser","Get-ADComputer","Get-DomainTrust","/domain_trusts",
        "Domain Admins","Enterprise Admins","whoami /all","ntdsutil",
        "ifm","create full","ProxyShell","autodiscover.json",
        "X-AnonResource","X-Rps-CAT"
      )
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildImage  = FolderPath,
          ChildCmd    = ProcessCommandLine,
          SHA256, ReportId
| summarize ChildBinaries = make_set(FileName, 50),
            SampleCmd    = any(ChildCmd),
            FirstSeen    = min(Timestamp),
            LastSeen     = max(Timestamp),
            DistinctChildren = dcount(ChildImage)
            by DeviceName, AccountName
| where DistinctChildren >= 2   // 2+ distinct recon/LOLBin children from w3wp = BlackByte hand-on-keyboard pattern
| order by LastSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// BlackByte (G1043) — Sentinel SecurityEvent 4688 view of w3wp spawning recon/LOLBins
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let ReconChildren = dynamic(["powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","nltest.exe","whoami.exe","ipconfig.exe","systeminfo.exe","tasklist.exe","wmic.exe","bitsadmin.exe","certutil.exe","ntdsutil.exe","sc.exe","reg.exe"]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where EventID == 4688
| where ParentProcessName endswith "\\w3wp.exe"
| extend ChildBin = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| where ChildBin in (ReconChildren)
   or CommandLine has_any (
        "Get-ADUser","Get-ADComputer","Get-DomainTrust","/domain_trusts",
        "Domain Admins","Enterprise Admins","whoami /all","ntdsutil",
        "ifm","create full","autodiscover.json","X-AnonResource","X-Rps-CAT"
      )
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, Account = SubjectUserName,
          ParentProcessName, NewProcessName, CommandLine
| summarize FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated),
            DistinctChildren = dcount(NewProcessName),
            ChildBinaries = make_set(NewProcessName, 50),
            SampleCmd = any(CommandLine)
            by Computer, Account
| where DistinctChildren >= 2
| order by LastSeen desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: BlackByte Exchange Exploitation - w3wp Spawning Recon LOLBins
id: 7c4a8d2f-9b1e-4f3c-a6d5-3e8f9b2c1a7d
status: experimental
description: Detects BlackByte (G1043) post-ProxyShell/ProxyNotShell exploitation pattern where IIS worker process w3wp.exe (Exchange app pool) spawns AD discovery and credential-access LOLBins.
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa22-238a
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1043/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/29
tags:
  - attack.initial-access
  - attack.t1190
  - attack.t1505.003
  - attack.discovery
  - attack.t1018
  - attack.t1087.002
  - attack.g1043
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  parent:
    ParentImage|endswith: '\w3wp.exe'
  selection_child_lolbin:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\net.exe'
      - '\net1.exe'
      - '\nltest.exe'
      - '\whoami.exe'
      - '\ntdsutil.exe'
      - '\wmic.exe'
      - '\bitsadmin.exe'
      - '\certutil.exe'
  selection_cmd_recon:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'Get-ADUser'
      - 'Get-ADComputer'
      - 'Get-DomainTrust'
      - '/domain_trusts'
      - 'Domain Admins'
      - 'Enterprise Admins'
      - 'whoami /all'
      - 'ntdsutil'
      - 'ifm'
      - 'create full'
  filter_machine_acct:
    User|endswith: '$'
  condition: parent and (selection_child_lolbin or selection_cmd_recon) and not filter_machine_acct
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate Exchange administration scripts run by admins
  - Monitoring tooling enumerating Exchange health
level: high

ucs.title: [LLM] BlackByte BYOVD — RTCore64.sys / DBUtil_2_3.sys driver drop chained to EDR-disable + vssadmin shadow-copy wipe
ucs.description: Hunts BlackByte's signature defense-evasion + impact chain: writing the vulnerable MSI Afterburner driver RTCore64.sys (CVE-2019-16098) or Dell DBUtil_2_3.sys (CVE-2021-21551), loading it as a service to kill EDR/AV callbacks, then immediately deleting volume shadow copies before encrypting. This BYOVD-then-wipe sequence within minutes is uniquely BlackByte (Sophos/Symantec reports, 2022-2023) and is not shared with most other ransomware families.
ucs.splunk: | tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Filesystem.file_path) as file_path values(Filesystem.process_id) as process_id from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where (Filesystem.file_name IN ("RTCore64.sys","DBUtil_2_3.sys","dbutildrv2.sys","gdrv.sys","mhyprot2.sys","procexp.sys")) by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.user Filesystem.file_name Filesystem.file_path Filesystem.process_id | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | join type=inner dest [| tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as shadow_time values(Processes.process) as shadow_cmd from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("vssadmin.exe","wmic.exe","powershell.exe") (Processes.process IN ("*shadowcopy*delete*","*shadows*/all*/quiet*","*Win32_ShadowCopy*Delete*","*Remove-Item*VSS*","*bcdedit*recoveryenabled*No*","*bcdedit*bootstatuspolicy*ignoreallfailures*","*wbadmin*delete*catalog*")) by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process Processes.process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where shadow_time>=relative_time(now(),"-1h")] | eval delta_seconds=abs(shadow_time-firstTime) | where delta_seconds <= 3600 | table firstTime dest user file_name file_path shadow_cmd delta_seconds | sort - firstTime
ucs.kql:
// BlackByte (G1043) — BYOVD vulnerable driver drop + shadow-copy wipe within 1h
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let WindowMin = 60m;
let BYOVDriversBlackByte = dynamic(["rtcore64.sys","dbutil_2_3.sys","dbutildrv2.sys","gdrv.sys","mhyprot2.sys","procexp.sys"]);
let DriverDrop = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileRenamed")
    | where tolower(FileName) in (BYOVDriversBlackByte)
    | project DriverDropTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName,
              DriverFile = FileName, DriverPath = FolderPath,
              DriverDropProc = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              DriverDropCmd  = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              DriverDropUser = InitiatingProcessAccountName;
let ShadowWipe = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where (FileName in~ ("vssadmin.exe","wmic.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","wbadmin.exe","bcdedit.exe"))
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any (
        "shadowcopy delete","shadows /all /quiet","delete shadows",
        "Win32_ShadowCopy","Remove-Item","recoveryenabled No",
        "bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures","delete catalog"
      )
    | project ShadowTime = Timestamp, DeviceId,
              ShadowProc = FileName, ShadowCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
              ShadowUser = AccountName;
DriverDrop
| join kind=inner ShadowWipe on DeviceId
| where abs(datetime_diff('minute', ShadowTime, DriverDropTime)) <= 60
| extend DeltaMin = datetime_diff('minute', ShadowTime, DriverDropTime)
| project DriverDropTime, ShadowTime, DeltaMin, DeviceName,
          DriverFile, DriverPath, DriverDropProc, DriverDropCmd, DriverDropUser,
          ShadowProc, ShadowCmd, ShadowUser
| order by DriverDropTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// BlackByte (G1043) — BYOVD driver write (4663/Sysmon 11) chained to shadow-copy wipe
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let WindowMin = 60m;
let BYOVDrivers = dynamic(["rtcore64.sys","dbutil_2_3.sys","dbutildrv2.sys","gdrv.sys","mhyprot2.sys","procexp.sys"]);
let DriverDrop = ImFileEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where EventType == "FileCreated"
    | where tolower(TargetFileName) in (BYOVDrivers) or tolower(TargetFilePath) has_any (BYOVDrivers)
    | project DriverDropTime = TimeGenerated, DvcHostname,
              DriverFile = TargetFileName, DriverPath = TargetFilePath,
              DriverDropProc = ActingProcessName,
              DriverDropCmd  = ActingProcessCommandLine,
              DriverDropUser = ActorUsername;
let ShadowWipe = ImProcessCreate
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where TargetProcessName endswith_cs "vssadmin.exe"
         or TargetProcessName endswith_cs "wmic.exe"
         or TargetProcessName endswith_cs "powershell.exe"
         or TargetProcessName endswith_cs "wbadmin.exe"
         or TargetProcessName endswith_cs "bcdedit.exe"
    | where TargetProcessCommandLine has_any (
        "shadowcopy delete","shadows /all /quiet","delete shadows",
        "Win32_ShadowCopy","recoveryenabled No",
        "bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures","delete catalog"
      )
    | project ShadowTime = TimeGenerated, DvcHostname,
              ShadowProc = TargetProcessName, ShadowCmd = TargetProcessCommandLine,
              ShadowUser = ActorUsername;
DriverDrop
| join kind=inner ShadowWipe on DvcHostname
| where abs(datetime_diff('minute', ShadowTime, DriverDropTime)) <= 60
| extend DeltaMin = datetime_diff('minute', ShadowTime, DriverDropTime)
| project DriverDropTime, ShadowTime, DeltaMin, DvcHostname,
          DriverFile, DriverPath, DriverDropProc, DriverDropCmd, DriverDropUser,
          ShadowProc, ShadowCmd, ShadowUser
| order by DriverDropTime desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.sysmon OR windows.security) AND ((@EventID:11 AND @TargetFilename:(*\RTCore64.sys OR *\rtcore64.sys OR *\RTCORE64.SYS OR *\DBUtil_2_3.sys OR *\dbutil_2_3.sys OR *\DBUTIL_2_3.SYS OR *\dbutildrv2.sys OR *\DBUtilDrv2.sys OR *\gdrv.sys OR *\GDRV.SYS OR *\mhyprot2.sys OR *\MHYPROT2.SYS)) OR (@EventID:1 AND @CommandLine:(*"shadowcopy delete"* OR *"shadows /all /quiet"* OR *"delete shadows"* OR *"Win32_ShadowCopy"* OR *"recoveryenabled No"* OR *"bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures"* OR *"delete catalog"*) AND @Image:(*\vssadmin.exe OR *\VSSADMIN.EXE OR *\wmic.exe OR *\WMIC.EXE OR *\powershell.exe OR *\PowerShell.exe OR *\wbadmin.exe OR *\bcdedit.exe OR *\BCDEDIT.EXE)))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
(#event_simpleName=FileWritten | regex("\\\\(rtcore64|dbutil_2_3|dbutildrv2|gdrv|mhyprot2|procexp)\\.sys$", field=TargetFileName, flags="i") | drop_proc := ContextImageFileName | drop_aid := aid | drop_time := @timestamp | drop_host := ComputerName | drop_driver := TargetFileName) 
| join({#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 | ImageFileName=/\\(vssadmin|wmic|powershell|pwsh|wbadmin|bcdedit)\.exe$/i | regex("(shadowcopy delete|shadows /all /quiet|delete shadows|Win32_ShadowCopy|recoveryenabled No|bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures|delete catalog)", field=CommandLine, flags="i")}, field=aid, include=[CommandLine, ImageFileName, @timestamp])
| groupBy([drop_aid, drop_host], function=[min(drop_time, as=driver_drop_time), max(@timestamp, as=shadow_wipe_time), collect([drop_driver, drop_proc, ImageFileName, CommandLine], multival=true)])
ucs.rationale: BlackByte's BYOVD playbook using MSI Afterburner's RTCore64.sys (CVE-2019-16098) was first publicly attributed in Sophos's October 2022 report 'Remove All The Callbacks' and reconfirmed in Symantec/Broadcom's 2023 BlackByte NT analysis; subsequent variants swapped to Dell's DBUtil_2_3.sys (CVE-2021-21551).
